newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African hikes key Bank rate one point to 17.
newsitem.headline: S.African hikes key Bank rate one point to 17.

text.p: South Africa's central Reserve Bank said on Wednesday it was increasing its key Bank rate to 17 percent from 16 percent, effective from November 21.
Governor Chris Stals said in a statement the move was necessary given the instability of the rand, rising short-term money market rates and the threat of higher inflation.

"The unstable conditions in the market for foreign exchange, recent developments in the domestic financial markets and the growing upward pressures on inflation all dictate a need for tightening monetary policy at this stage," Stals said.
